title: Subordinate court staff go on indefinite strike over pay parity

ai.summary: Subordinate court staff in Maharashtra began an indefinite strike demanding pay parity with High Court staff, citing heavier workloads and government inaction.

facts.claim: 34,000 subordinate court employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, demanding a revised pay scale on par with Bombay High Court staff
facts.quote: 34,000 subordinate court employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, demanding a revised pay scale on par with Bombay High Court staff.

facts.claim: The strike disrupted work in courts across Mumbai, with hundreds of employees gathering outside the Sessions Court in Fort
facts.quote: The strike disrupted work in courts across Mumbai, with hundreds of employees gathering outside the Sessions Court in Fort.

facts.claim: Satish Mundhe, president of the Nyayalayin Karmachari Mahasangh’s Bombay City Civil and Sessions Court unit, said employees of subordinate courts performed work similar to that of their counterparts in the High Court but did not receive the same revised pay scale
facts.quote: Satish Mundhe, president of the Nyayalayin Karmachari Mahasangh’s Bombay City Civil and Sessions Court unit, said employees of subordinate courts performed work similar to that of their counterparts in the High Court but did not receive the same revised pay scale.

facts.claim: The revised scale had been applicable to High Court employees since 2006, while subordinate court employees continued to seek the benefit under the principle of “equal work, equal pay”
facts.quote: The revised scale had been applicable to High Court employees since 2006, while subordinate court employees continued to seek the benefit under the principle of “equal work, equal pay”.

facts.claim: In January 2025, following repeated representations, the High Court administration submitted a proposal to the state government seeking the revised pay scale for subordinate court employees. However, the government had not acted on it despite giving assurances, he alleged
facts.quote: In January 2025, following repeated representations, the High Court administration submitted a proposal to the state government seeking the revised pay scale for subordinate court employees. However, the government had not acted on it despite giving assurances, he alleged.

facts.claim: The employees had earlier staged protests by wearing black ribbons in September and October
facts.quote: The employees had earlier staged protests by wearing black ribbons in September and October.

facts.claim: They had also called for a mass leave agitation on November 5, which was withdrawn after the High Court issued a circular
facts.quote: They had also called for a mass leave agitation on November 5, which was withdrawn after the High Court issued a circular.

facts.claim: Another union leader said the workload of subordinate court employees had increased substantially with the rise in litigation
facts.quote: Another union leader said the workload of subordinate court employees had increased substantially with the rise in litigation.

facts.claim: Although computer systems were introduced in subordinate courts in 2005, they continue to operate on an “experimental” basis, forcing employees to carry out manual work alongside computerised tasks
facts.quote: Although computer systems were introduced in subordinate courts in 2005, they continue to operate on an “experimental” basis, forcing employees to carry out manual work alongside computerised tasks
